name: snapinvoice
description: SnapInvoice: phone photos of invoices become ready-to-import data for accountants.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @snapinvoice/api" "npm run dev -w @snapinvoice/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snapinvoice/api && npm run build -w @snapinvoice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @snapinvoice/api && npm run build -w @snapinvoice/web
